requirements.title: Recover missing sidewalk row headings

requirements.title: Reconcile overlapping work
requirements.description: Identify which priced projects own each overlapping REF entry and chainage interval. Confirm complete, nonoverlapping replacement scopes.

requirements.title: Reconcile published cost arithmetic

requirements.title: Find the Route 28 W assessment and cost
requirements.description: Locate the missing inventory and cost record, including assessed dimensions and chainage. The route is mapped without a matching master cost row.

requirements.title: Assess continuous route conditions
requirements.description: Document crossing surfaces, approach grades, usable width, obstructions and entrance access, or establish a supportable recorded-barrier policy.

requirements.title: Verify remaining barriers and repair scope
requirements.description: Inventory remaining barriers and confirm the full post-repair scope on any end-to-end route before crediting a connection.
